arguments.content: P1 review pattern: enabling an existing optional calculation by default can turn a previously opt-in boundary defect into a default-path regression. In the batch-report staged review against HEAD a21036447ee7843887ddbaff82408db6e044b053, all four existing tests passed, but historical/index snapshot probes showed report([]) changing from 'Items: 0' to ZeroDivisionError. Explicit detailed=True failed in both snapshots; detailed=False remained valid. Default activation reviews must exercise required boundary inputs through unchanged downstream consumers and compare with the review base, separating inherited behavior from newly exposed impact. Correction here: omit the mean key for empty batches so the existing formatter can return the count; cover default and explicit detailed empty calls.
